### 📅 WEEKLY CHECKLIST

- Track **new listings** — Note all new 2‑room units with lift + parking in your €200–250k range.  
  - Villach 2-Zimmer 45-65m2 150-300 K Kauf
  - Suchagent Willhaben, ImmoScout24, Immowelt, Sandard Immobilien = 90% coverage
  
- Record days on market — Anything > 60 days becomes a negotiation target.  
- Monitor price reductions — Look for 2nd reductions (seller fatigue).  
- Check Betriebskosten — Flag any unit with < €3.50/m² as high‑quality.  
- Review HOA reserve funds — Avoid buildings with low Rücklage or planned renovations.  
- Check Infineon hiring cycles — Rental demand spikes → liquidity improves.  
- Track supply in your target buildings — If a rare unit appears, act fast.  
- Monitor interest rate news — Lower rates → more buyers → less negotiation power.  
- Check lake‑adjacent micro‑markets — Landskron, Viktring outskirts, St. Ruprecht.  
- Review rental market speed — Confirms liquidity and exit flexibility.  
- Track developer inventory — Oversupply = negotiation leverage.  
- Watch for probate/estate sales — Often 10–15% below market.  
- Check for upcoming renovations — Façade/lift = €15–25k risk.  
- Maintain your shortlist — Update your top 10–12 buildings weekly.
